result: Sofia sketched a fish and split the work: Omar on the top of the body, Hana on the belly, Jack on the tail. The first snag came at the nose, where Omar's top line stayed pale. Hana found the cause: "the top line breaks just past the nose, where one domino is jammed and the next sits off to the side." She cleared the jammed domino and bridged the gap, and the line turned dark. Jack closed the tail loop back toward the belly. Sofia checked the middle crossing, where a small sideways offset had shown up, and kept her hands off once it held. As time ran down, the team agreed to leave the fish alone. When the push came, Jack called, "Here it goes!" In the end, 108 of 111 dominoes fell, and the judges saw a fish.
